items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: I heard this Ike Dixon and Ford Dabney then Fletcher Henderson come down and shook everybody up

ctx.x: So I was so excited that I just left, just cut out. So then I wrote my mother when I was on the road, went on down to [St.] (Virginia) Petersburg and I was so happy. The man wasn't paying me nothing.

Oh, you know, it's awful the theatre manager, owe for the drops, and I wasn't getting nothing, just enough to eat with, but I was happy, but I was so happy, man, so then we played all that summer. I wrote my mother (unintelligible) and she said what about school and I barely made it, so I just dropped out, just disappeared and then -- but I had gotten that bug and then I was saying, then I heard this Ike Dixon and Ford Dabney then Fletcher Henderson come down and shook everybody up and at that time, now, Duke had…
